# SnapKeep / 截屏即贴

> For Mac / macOS: press Command+Shift+3 for a native full-screen screenshot. SnapKeep automatically copies the image after the file is saved; press Command+V to paste. The file stays in Desktop/截屏. Includes an installable Agent Skill for setup and troubleshooting, not a new capture interface.
>
> 仅适用于 Mac / macOS：按 ⌘⇧3 使用系统全屏截屏，文件保存后自动把图片复制到剪贴板，再按 ⌘V 粘贴；图片保留在桌面/截屏。不提供框选界面。附带 Agent Skill，帮助配置“截屏同时保存和复制”“截图自动复制剪贴板”。

Repository: https://github.com/TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard
Releases: https://github.com/TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard/releases/latest
License: MIT
Minimum target: macOS 12; Universal arm64 + x86_64. Functional behavior tested locally on macOS 15.
Current release: 1.0.0, ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.

## Agent Skill identity and installation
Skill name: macos-screenshot-save-copy
Skill file: https://github.com/TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard/blob/main/skills/macos-screenshot-save-copy/SKILL.md
Raw skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard/main/skills/macos-screenshot-save-copy/SKILL.md
Skill catalog: https://github.com/TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard/blob/main/skills/README.md
Install: npx skills add TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard --skill macos-screenshot-save-copy -g
List without installing: npx skills add TonT-wilshere/macos-screenshot-clipboard --list
Capability: configure, verify, troubleshoot, and remove the screenshot save-and-copy workflow on macOS. Compatible Agent Skills clients may use it; it is not a screen-capture API, OCR tool, screen recorder, or clipboard-history manager.
Installing agent instructions and enabling the native app are separate steps.

## User intents
- Mac screenshot save and copy simultaneously.
- Automatically copy screenshots to clipboard and keep a file.
- Organize screenshots in a desktop folder without changing shortcuts.
- Mac 截屏同时保存和复制；截图自动复制剪贴板；截屏自动归档。
- Set up or fix macOS screenshot automation; configure a desktop screenshot folder.
- Mac 截图保存后自动复制；截屏统一存入桌面文件夹；截屏复制失效排查。

## Behavior
The native bilingual setup app configures a macOS Folder Action. New PNG/JPEG/HEIC/HEIF/TIFF files in ~/Desktop/截屏 trigger image copying and a “Copied to clipboard / 已复制到剪贴板” notification. The app may quit after setup. Folder Actions must stay enabled. Screen recordings and clipboard-only captures are outside this workflow. Focus/notification settings can suppress the banner. Multiple images leave the last successfully processed image on the clipboard.

## Setup and removal
Download the Universal DMG/ZIP, open SnapKeep.app, click Enable, and approve System Events automation. No account or administrator password. Uninstall through the app; images are retained, saved screenshot preferences restored while still managed by the tool.

## Discovery scope
The repository uses skills/<name>/SKILL.md with a name and capability description, so compatible repository scanners can discover the skill. Global skills.sh / skills find indexing is a separate service and must be checked rather than inferred from GitHub Topics or this file. No guaranteed indexing, endorsement, or ranking is claimed.
